summary_name: Exploration Round 7 Stage 7A Epistemic Privilege Escalation & Security Summary

epistemic_privilege_escalation_invariant.principal_bound_capabilities: CapabilityPolicyRegistry keyed strictly by AuthenticatedOrigin.verified_id; textually claimed roles are untrusted metadata. Disambiguation privilege is fail-closed (can_disambiguate=False by default).
epistemic_privilege_escalation_invariant.epistemic_independence_decoupling: OriginIdentity != DerivationLineage != IndependenceClass; unmapped origins strictly default to ROOT_UNKNOWN_INDEPENDENCE.
epistemic_privilege_escalation_invariant.independent_certificate_verifier: CertificateVerifier derives TrustedSourceContext internally; callers cannot inject forged trusted contexts.
epistemic_privilege_escalation_invariant.proof_carrying_resolution: ResolutionCertificate enforces candidate set containment (chosen in B(x)), disambiguation authorization, and sensor provenance preservation.
epistemic_privilege_escalation_invariant.proof_carrying_promotion: PromotionCertificate enforces ontology collision prevention, CANONICAL_ONTOLOGY_ADMIN capability, and rejects promotion of relations from ATTESTATION_ONLY sources.
epistemic_privilege_escalation_invariant.dual_novel_status_laundering_prevention: Provisional relations involving multiple provisional endpoints remain provisional until all endpoints are canonical before migrating to authoritative facts.

probe_separation_8_worlds_assay.description: Eight-world assay containing three explicitly decoupled mechanism profiles plus full-pass, redundancy, conflict-isolation, and rejection controls.
